items.title: 2.2.1.2 Variable Naming Rules in Python (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of naming rules (PDF 36).

blocks.text: Python mein variable ke naam in qawaid (rules) ke mutabiq hone chahiyein:

items: Naam kisi letter (a-z, A-Z) ya underscore ( _ ) se shuru ho.
Baad ke characters letters, digits (0-9) ya underscores ho sakte hain.
Naam case-sensitive hain, yani age aur Age do alag variables hain.
Python ke reserved keywords (makhsoos alfaaz), jaise for, while, if waghera, variable ka naam nahi ban sakte.

blocks.title: Tidbits
blocks.text: Variables ke naam hamesha ba-maani (meaningful) rakhein ta ke code samajhna aasan ho. Maslan a ki bajaye age likhein.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Durust naam: age, student_name, _total, marks2. Ghalat naam: 2marks (digit se shuru), student-name (hyphen), student name (space), for (keyword).

blocks.prompt: In mein se kaunsa durust variable naam hai: variable1, 1variable, variable-name, variable name (MCQ 3)?
blocks.explanation: variable1, option (a); baqi adad se shuru hote ya hyphen ya space rakhte hain.

items: Naam letter ya _ se shuru; phir letters, digits, _.
Case-sensitive; keywords mana; ba-maani naam rakhein.
